title: The founding menu, rebuilt as a menu
question: Driving this with the arrows, WASD or the mouse — is anything still unreachable or unclear? (The blue bar in the margin is where the cursor is; the arrow on LINE 1 is which lineage is chosen.)
context_md:
Your playtest: *"the found menu needs to be way improved. it should be fully controlled by arrow keys and/or wasd and/or mouse. When I change things they should stay as the default next time I open the menu. The game should pause when in the founding menu."*

The old screen bound six unrelated letters, one per dial — which is the shortcut list you objected to elsewhere, wearing a panel. It is a **list with a cursor** now: up and down walk it, left and right work whatever the cursor is on, ENTER chooses, and every row has a hit box so the pointer reaches all of it. The two dials wear their own `<` and `>` so the mouse has something to aim at. All the old letters still work.

**The other two clauses are done and are not things a picture can show**, so here are their numbers instead:

- **Pause.** With the screen open, twenty ticks of the game move the clock by **0**; with it shut the same twenty move it by **20**. Time stops because the screen is up, rather than by flipping your own pause — so closing it cannot accidentally un-pause a game you had deliberately stopped.
- **Sticky.** Body, count, chosen lineage and cursor position all survive a close now. They did not before: the screen was rebuilt from scratch on every open. The same bug was eating the reroll — committing drew a fresh three and then threw them away, so "committing costs you the other two" had never once happened in the game. It does now.

Same world, same crop, same scale.
